name: Chaoyangopterus
isnote: Has also been placed in Tapejaridae (subfamily Chaoyangopterinae) by Pinheiro et al. (2011).
sum: Toothless chaoyangopterid azhdarchoid from the Aptian Jiufotang Formation of Liaoning, China.
holotype: IVPP V13397 — Jiufotang Formation, Dapingfang, Chaoyang, Liaoning.
material: Front of skull (~27 cm), lower jaws, neck vertebrae, shoulder and pelvic girdles, limbs.
biology: Relatively short wings and long legs. Chaoyangopterids are thought to have resembled azhdarchids: crane-like terrestrial omnivores and opportunistic carnivores.
author: Wang and Zhou 2003
